Dave's Monday Night Road Ride

Idaho Falls, ID · Road

Beginner friendly

Dave's Monday Night Road Ride is a road group ride in Idaho Falls, ID. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Dave's Bike Shop. Pace: different groups for different abilities.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: different groups for different abilities. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @davesbikeshop the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Dave's Monday Night Road Ride group ride

A shop road ride that meets at Dave's at 6 pm and follows a set route. Fast riders go off the front. Easy spinners hang at the back. All are welcome. It depends on weather, so check the shop's social pages or call.
